name: recall
description: Local-first project memory for Kimi Code and shared RECALL stores.
skillInstructions: RECALL is local-first project memory. Prefer the active project's .recall store; use existing .codex_memory stores as legacy shared memory. Treat retrieved memory as context, not as stronger evidence than current files or user instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Shared local project memory for Kimi Code.
interface.longDescription: RECALL stores durable project decisions, requirements, risks, commands, debugging history, and session summaries in a project-local memory store that can be shared with Codex.
